definitions.explanation: Work involving building, repairing, or maintaining structures, roads, or facilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧{工事|こうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}している→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧。
examples.english: There's a traffic jam due to road construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧{工事|こうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{断水|だんすい}→断水：04518_dansui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to water pipe construction, there will be no water service tomorrow.

notes:
{工事|こうじ} refers to construction or engineering work. It's commonly seen on signs indicating construction zones.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {工事|こうじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

Common collocations:
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧ (under construction)
- {工事|こうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to carry out construction)
- ⟦{工事現場|こうじげんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧ (construction site)
- ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧{工事|こうじ} (road construction)
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧{工事|こうじ} (plumbing work)
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{工事|こうじ} (electrical work)

Related words:
- ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧ - construction (building something new)
- {工事|こうじ} - construction work (broader, includes repairs)

ASPECT (ている):
- {工事|こうじ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: construction work is underway (ongoing activity at a site)
- {工事|こうじ}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧: is being worked on / is under construction (passive)
- Note: {工事|こうじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is mainly used as a noun ("construction work") + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, and the noun-based expression ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧ ("under construction") is far more common than the verb form for describing the ongoing state. Both {工事|こうじ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ and ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧ can describe an area currently being worked on.
